## Forest Economics Forecast Portal

This site hosts internal forecasts and exploratory analysis for the economics group.  
Content is updated regularly and intended for internal use.

---

## Dashboards

- **[West Boundary Agricultural Water Security](water-security.qmd)**  
  A pilot dashboard for the RDKB West Boundary planning process (Kettle River
  watershed, Midway and upstream), including:
  - current flow status for each monitoring station, scored against decades of record
  - an interactive drought view comparing this year's flow to the historical normal range
  - a project-area map of stations and communities, plus seasonal climatology

---

## Notes on methodology

Forecasts on this site are intentionally lightweight and transparent.
Where applicable, we use simple time-series benchmarks (e.g. random walk variants)
to provide context rather than precise prediction.
